manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a tossed ball passing through the top of its flight with a ball released from rest at the same moment.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side lanes track a tossed ball and a second ball held at the apex. At the top, the tossed ball's velocity passes through zero while acceleration remains equal to gravity downward.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
